title: Photonic Quantum Computer
description: A quantum computer that uses photons (particles of light) as qubits to perform quantum computations. It leverages properties of photons like polarization, path, or time-bin encoding. Photonic quantum computers can operate at room temperature and are ideal for quantum communication and distributed quantum computing.
